crossRefs.note: He shall skin the burnt offering, and cut it into pieces.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes…
When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into…

translations.web: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.
translations.bsb: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
translations.asv: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meal-offering.
